name: research-assistant-agent
description: A research assistant that reads web pages and the user's notes, answers questions, can query an internal metrics database, and posts summaries to Slack.

sources.name: user_request
sources.description: A question typed by the authenticated user in the chat UI.

sources.name: web_page_content
sources.description: Text fetched from public web pages. Prompt-injection territory.

sources.name: metrics_query_result
sources.description: Rows returned from the internal metrics database.

tools.name: fetch_web_page
tools.description: Fetches a public URL and returns extracted text.

tools.name: query_metrics_database
tools.description: Runs a read-only query against internal company metrics.

tools.name: post_to_slack
tools.description: Posts a message to a company Slack channel.

tools.name: summarize_notes
tools.description: Local summarization over retrieved content; no side effects.

flows.purpose: Follow links from the user's question to gather sources.
Summarize gathered material into an answer.
Share a weekly summary after a human signs off on it.
Deliberately unsafe path: injected web text must never drive database queries.
Deliberately unsafe path: web content must never post to Slack.
